title: The Genstone Companies | Genstone Construction
metaDescription: Realty, financing, insurance, property management, field services and title under one network. See how the Genstone Companies support each investment stage.
h1: All You Need, All Under One Roof
lede: Real estate investing involves more than the renovation. Through the Genstone network, investors can reach specialized help across brokerage, lending, insurance, construction, inspections and maintenance, title services and property management. Together, these companies can support an asset at every stage of the investment lifecycle, from acquisition and renovation through ownership and eventual exit.

sections.h2: Why a connected network matters to an investor
sections.body:
A typical investment property touches half a dozen businesses before it ever produces a return. An agent finds it, a lender funds it, an insurer covers it while it sits vacant, a title company closes it, a contractor renovates it, and then either a listing agent sells it or a property manager leases it. Each handoff is a place where information gets lost. The lender doesn't have the contractor's draw schedule. The insurer doesn't know the property went from vacant to under construction to occupied. The property manager inherits a house with no record of what was replaced.

Each Genstone company brings specialized expertise to a different part of that lifecycle. If you're buying a single property, the network can connect you with the services that deal needs. If you're managing a growing portfolio, the same companies can scale with you as your needs change. You can use one Genstone company or several. The value of the network is that when you use more than one, they already know how to work with each other.

Genstone Realty is a full-service real estate brokerage supporting investors, REO opportunities and residential transactions. Its services include:

- Investor and residential brokerage
- Off-market opportunities
- Property acquisition and disposition
- Local market expertise

For an investor, a brokerage that understands investment math is useful on both ends of a deal. On the way in, it can surface properties, including off-market and REO opportunities, and help you evaluate them against comparable sales. On the way out, it handles disposition, whether that's listing a finished flip for retail buyers or selling a rental to another investor. Pairing acquisition support with a Pre-Offer Rehab Review from Genstone Construction gives you a repair estimate and a refined ARV before you write the offer.

Genstone Financial provides financing for real estate investors, from individual acquisitions to growing rental portfolios. Its programs include:

- DSCR rental loans
- Fix and flip loans
- Lines of credit
- New construction loans

Financing and renovation are closely tied on most investor deals. A fix and flip loan typically funds the renovation in draws as work is completed, which means the lender, the contractor and the investor all need to agree on the scope and the draw schedule. A DSCR rental loan is underwritten largely on the property's rental income, which is why the quality of the renovation and the rent it supports matter so much on a BRRRR refinance. When the scope comes from Genstone Construction and the loan comes from Genstone Financial, those pieces start out aligned. More detail is on the investor financing page.

Genstone Insurance offers real estate investment insurance for landlords, fix and flip investors, vacant properties and portfolios nationwide. Coverage areas include:

- Rental property coverage
- Fix and flip coverage
- Vacant property coverage
- Multi-property and portfolio coverage
- REIT and professional investor solutions

Insurance is easy to get wrong on an investment property because the property's status keeps changing. A house can be vacant at purchase, under active renovation for a period, listed for sale or leased to a tenant, and a standard homeowner's policy isn't written for any of those situations. Matching coverage to each stage, and to a portfolio as it grows, is the job Genstone Insurance is built for.

Genstone Property Management provides full-service property management for real estate investors, helping owners market, lease, maintain and manage rental properties across growing portfolios. Services include:

- Rental marketing and leasing
- Resident screening
- Rent collection
- Maintenance coordination
- Owner reporting and financials

For a BRRRR or buy-and-hold investor, the renovation and the management are two halves of the same plan. The materials chosen during the rehab determine how often the manager has to send a technician and how much a turnover costs. A manager who knows what was installed, and when, can make better calls on repair versus replace and give the owner more accurate reporting.

Genstone Field Services provides nationwide property services that help investors protect, maintain and monitor real estate assets throughout ownership. Its work covers:

- Property preservation
- Property inspections
- Occupied maintenance and repairs
- Turn and make-ready services
- Code compliance and property care

Field services fill the gaps around a renovation. Before a project starts, a vacant property may need securing, winterizing or a condition inspection. After a rental is leased, occupied maintenance and repairs keep it in good shape. Between tenants, turn and make-ready work gets the unit back on the market. Code compliance work helps owners respond to municipal notices, which are common on vacant and bank-owned houses.

Title Clearing & Escrow provides nationwide title and settlement services for real estate investors, with localized expertise supporting acquisition, closing, title clearance and post-closing needs. Services include:

- Title insurance
- Title clearance and curative services
- Settlement and closing services
- Lien release processing
- Post-closing loan reviews

Title problems are a particular risk on distressed and REO properties, where old liens, unreleased mortgages and gaps in the chain of title are more common than on a typical retail sale. Curative work and lien release processing help clear those issues so the property can close and, later, sell or refinance without a surprise.

sections.h2: How the companies work together across the investment lifecycle
sections.body:
Here is how a single property can move through the network from start to finish.

Acquisition. Genstone Realty identifies a property, possibly an off-market house or an REO listing. Genstone Construction runs a Pre-Offer Rehab Review to estimate repairs and refine the ARV. Genstone Financial structures a fix and flip loan or other acquisition financing. Genstone Insurance writes vacant property or fix and flip coverage, and Title Clearing & Escrow clears title and handles the closing.

Renovation. Genstone Field Services can secure and inspect the property while the scope is finalized. Genstone Construction delivers the detailed scope, estimate and draw schedule, then manages the renovation through vetted local contractors, with permits, inspections and lien waivers handled as the work progresses. Draws line up with the financing.

Ownership. For a rental, Genstone Property Management markets the property, screens residents and collects rent. Genstone Financial can refinance into a DSCR rental loan. Field Services handles occupied maintenance and turns, and the insurance coverage moves from vacant and renovation to rental.

Exit. When it's time to sell, Genstone Realty handles disposition, and Title Clearing & Escrow manages settlement and any lien releases.

You don't need to use every company to work with any one of them. The point is that the pieces are there when the plan calls for them.

sections.h2: What this looks like for different kinds of investors
sections.body:
The same network serves very different clients, and each tends to use it differently.

A first-time flipper might lean on Genstone Realty to find and evaluate a property, Genstone Construction for the rehab review and renovation, Genstone Financial for a fix and flip loan, and Genstone Insurance for coverage while the house is under construction. Having those pieces coordinate removes a lot of the guesswork from a first deal.

A buy-and-hold investor building a rental portfolio might use Genstone Construction to bring each new acquisition up to one standard, Genstone Property Management to lease and run the properties, Genstone Field Services for turns and maintenance, and Genstone Financial for DSCR loans as each property is stabilized.

Institutional clients such as mortgage servicers, banks, REITs and investment funds often use Field Services for preservation and inspections on vacant and REO properties, Genstone Construction for renovations, and Title Clearing & Escrow for curative and lien release work before disposition. Genstone Construction is also a preferred contractor for Government-Sponsored Enterprises.

Each company in the network can be reached directly. If you aren't sure which one you need, start with Genstone Construction at (312) 429-2637. Most investor conversations begin with the property and the renovation, and we can connect you with the rest of the network from there.
